games.title: Crystal Caverns
games.author: GemSpark Studios
games.shortDescription: Explore glittering underground caves as a curious unicorn.
games.fullDescription: Crystal Caverns is a short exploration adventure where you guide a unicorn through procedurally lit caverns, solving light-based puzzles and collecting gems. Perfect for a cozy evening play session.

games.title: Sky Race Derby
games.author: CloudChaser Dev
games.shortDescription: High-speed pegasus racing through cloud-filled courses.
games.fullDescription: Take to the skies in this fast-paced pegasus racing game. Drift around cloud rings, boost through rainbows, and compete for the fastest lap times across five unique tracks.

games.title: Friendship Garden
games.author: CozyHoof Games
games.shortDescription: A relaxing farming sim about growing bonds and flowers.
games.fullDescription: Plant seeds, tend to your garden, and invite pony friends over for tea parties. Friendship Garden focuses on cozy gameplay with no timers or pressure, just peaceful pony life.

games.title: Night Guard Duty
games.author: ShadowMane Interactive
games.shortDescription: A spooky tower-defense game set on the castle walls.
games.fullDescription: The castle is under siege by shadow creatures! As a royal guard, place defenses along the ramparts and protect the kingdom through the night. Features multiple difficulty modes and unlockable guard ponies.

games.title: Mane Style Studio
games.author: GlamourWorks
games.shortDescription: Design and share custom mane styles for your favorite ponies.
games.fullDescription: Unleash your inner stylist in Mane Style Studio. Mix colors, add accessories, and export your creations to share with the community. Includes a library of canon and OC pony bases.

games.title: Everfree Quest
games.author: ForestPath RPG
games.shortDescription: A turn-based RPG deep in the mysterious Everfree Forest.
games.fullDescription: Venture into the Everfree Forest with a party of four ponies. Battle wild creatures, discover ancient ruins, and uncover the secrets of the forest in this classic turn-based RPG with a pony twist.
